page_title: ROM 1-0 SAS | AS Roma v Sassuolo 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Gianluca Manganiello signals.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sassuolo.
89' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

88' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom left corner, but great anticipation by Andrea Consigli allowed him to make a comfortable save.
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mattia Viti will be replaced by Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo).
86' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Romelu Lukaku and he is replaced by Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) will replace Stephan El Shaarawy.
84' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
79' Substitution. Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) on for Uros Racic.
79' Davide Ballardini has decided to make a change. Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) replaces Andrea Pinamonti.
79' Ball possession – 65:35.
73' Substitution. Gregoire Defrel will be replaced by Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo).
73' Excellent touch by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
72' Here comes a substitution. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Pedro Obiang.
70' Daniele De Rossi prepares a substitution. Houssem Aouar is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
70' Rick Karsdorp goes off the pitch and Zeki Celik (AS Roma) comes on.
69' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
69' Chance! Uros Racic (Sassuolo) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but Mile Svilar is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
67' Pedro Obiang (Sassuolo) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
66' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
66' The referee points to the corner flag and AS Roma will take a corner.
65' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

63' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
59' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) has tested the patience of referee Gianluca Manganiello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
59' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
59' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
58' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaps to collect the ball.

57' This should have been a goal! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) sends a killer pass into the box, but Armand Lauriente can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession. Sassuolo force a corner. They send men into the box.
56' It will be a corner kick for AS Roma.
54' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.

50' 1 - 0 What a spectacular moment! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) skips past defenders and finds some space before blasting a long-range strike at goal. The fans are amazed when they see the ball go into the bottom right corner. The scoreline is 1:0.
49' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Houssem Aouar (AS Roma), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AS Roma comes to nothing.
45+3' Angelino (AS Roma) produces a cunning chipped pass for Romelu Lukaku, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Manganiello signals a set piece. Free kick. AS Roma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
43' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

43' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
41' Sassuolo get a corner.

41' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
37' Daniele De Rossi decides to make a substitution. Leonardo Spinazzola will be replaced by Angelino (AS Roma).
35' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andrea Consigli, who smothers the ball.
35' AS Roma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
31' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andrea Consigli intercepts the ball.
27' Dangerous play by Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma). Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
25' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
24' A pass lands at the feet of Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Now Sassuolo have a corner.
22' Pedro Obiang (Sassuolo) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
19' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
18' Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul after Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
17' The percentage of ball possession is – 66:34.
13' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
12' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
9' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) tackles a bit over-zealously and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
7' AS Roma hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.
4' A cross from Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
1' The first half has just begun.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Gianluca Manganiello got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
